concerns.text: Task T018b (Execute fetching logic) is marked as a dependency for T019 (Geospatial matching) and T020 (Interpolation), but T018b itself depends on T002c (Fetch full dataset) which is marked [ ] (incomplete). The data-flow is broken: T019/T020 cannot consume the merged dataset until T002c and T018b successfully produce `data/raw/era5_full.h5` and the intermediate merge artifact. The current ordering implies T019 can run before the full data fetch is executed.

Task T022 (Output generation) depends on T018b, but T018b is currently incomplete. Furthermore, T022 is listed as a dependency for T026 (Modeling) and T045 (Stratified analysis). The ordering creates a circular verification block where the output task (T022) cannot be verified as complete until the input task (T018b) succeeds, yet T018b is marked as a prerequisite for the very tasks that validate the output.

Task T028 (Derivation of Age/Gender Covariates) is listed as a dependency for T026 (Primary Model). However, T028 involves fetching external World Bank data. The task description does not explicitly state that this fetch must complete and the data must be merged into the dataset *before* T026 runs. If T026 runs before T028 completes, the model will lack the required covariates defined in FR-004. The dependency chain is implied but not enforced by the task ordering structure.

Task T045 (Stratified analysis) depends on T026 (Primary Model) and T022 (Output generation). However, T045 also requires the `merged_dataset.parquet` (from T022) to be available. The current ordering places T045 after T026, but T026 itself depends on T022. This creates a valid chain, but the description of T045 mentions 'Re-run the primary temperature model (T026 logic)', which implies T026 must be fully implemented and executable. If T026 is not yet runnable (due to T028 or T022 issues), T045 cannot proceed. The dependency on T022 is explicit, but the dependency on the *execution* of T026 is implicit and risky.

Task T002b (Write script to fetch full dataset) is marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, it writes to `data/raw/era5_full.h5`. If T002c (Execute script) is also marked [P] and runs in parallel with T002b, there is a race condition where T002c might attempt to execute the script before T002b has finished writing it. While T002c depends on T002b in the text, the [P] tag on T002b is misleading if it implies it can run independently of the script creation phase.
